note: Stable and Preview cumulative download totals of the days before the ledger kept them (ADR-0163), rebuilt on 2026-11-23 and extended on 2026-11-26 from the copies of the ledger that Actions kept (artifact downloads-ledger, one per run) by taking the last copy of each date; a day is listed only when Stable + Preview equals the total of the history. A tag with an even middle number is Stable, an odd one Preview (ADR-0090). The build fills the days of the history that lack the split from this file and never overwrites a day that has it.
